history: The earlier optimization had already been promoted on 2026-08-31. This cross-audit made no author-layer or formal-archive change.

author_layer.excluded: Shared chassis, vendored GSAP, image assets, verification scripts and generated screenshots.
author_layer.cross_audit_result: Byte-identical. The staged author file is readable, non-minified and exactly matches the previously promoted formal file.

model_evidence.assessment: Movement, obstacle rejection, unique-visit coverage, undirected repeated-edge counting and efficiency are derived from the live path rather than scripted result labels.

preserved_changes: A fresh model factory owns initial and reset state.
Keyboard, D-pad and touch swipe all enter the same movement transition.
pointercancel and lostpointercapture release gesture ownership without leaving input stuck.
pagehide teardown clears timers, GSAP work, autofit handles and page-owned listeners.

visual_regression.stored_pair_result: All baseline/candidate PNG pairs are pixel-identical.

tests.name: Canvas failure path
tests.result: With getContext returning null, controls and the true path model still reach 48/48 and 100%; the missing canvas is an auxiliary-renderer loss rather than fabricated evidence.

tests.name: runtime ownership
tests.result: No unexpected console, page or request errors; input is inert after pagehide and functional again after reload.

cross_audit.report_correction: archive_modified now describes this audit rather than the earlier promotion; candidate/formal equality and the independent two-size matrix are recorded explicitly.

mini.basis: The improved full is 26,499 characters, well above the 10,000-character exemption.

rejected_changes: No extra reduced-motion CSS was kept because the shared chassis already collapses animation and transition duration to 0.01ms; duplicating it would add no behavior.
No renderer layer, input route, result state or live path computation was removed for character savings.
